# Ownership and filing

Fill this table with team-approved ownership and filing rules.

| Component or area | Team | Owner | Tracker/project | Required fields |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<component>` | `<team>` | `<owner>` | `<project>` | `<fields>` |

## Required work-item fields

Every proposed new work item should identify:

- title
- component or area
- environment
- version
- evidence links
- observed time window
- severity or priority
- owner/team
- related fingerprint or existing work item

The agent proposes fields only. It must not create or update tracker items
without explicit user approval.
